decisions.reason: Extending the calendar date-selection behavior to additional templates does not change normal-Enter multiline support.
The date-picker scope extension does not necessarily change the separately established Board Meeting dropdown control.
Hard-return paragraph spacing is independent of applying the calendar date-selection method to additional templates.
The date-picker scope extension does not alter word wrapping or column-containment behavior.
Applying consistent date functionality does not change the visual cues or empty-field visibility required for editable fields.
The date-field scope decision does not replace or modify the architecture selected for ordinary text-entry fields.
The Indstilling checklist control remains valid unchanged by the date-picker scope extension.
Board Meeting field alignment is a separate behavior and is not changed by adopting the Board Seminar date functionality.
The message independently reports placeholder-clearing failures, but the source date-picker scope change does not itself modify the placeholder-clearing requirement.
The behavior of extra lines and unintended borders in Board Meeting rows is independent of date-picker scope.
Extending date selection to additional templates does not affect whether interactive fields maintain independent content.
The date-picker scope extension does not change the existing label text, access, placement, or persistence rules for control fields.
